Create a ConcordanceRule object

Source: R/methods.R
ConcordanceRule.Rd

Says how the technical replicates of a sample must agree, for use as the replicateConc of an ISNVFilter.

Usage

ConcordanceRule(freqTolerance = 0.05, requireBothDetected = TRUE)

Arguments

freqTolerance

Numeric. The largest difference in allele frequency allowed between two replicates that both made the call (default: 0.05); Inf compares no frequencies.

requireBothDetected

Logical. Whether a site called in one replicate of a pair but not in the other fails (default: TRUE).

Value

A ConcordanceRule object.

Details

Neither argument is converted from another type: a factor, a string or a logical freqTolerance is an error, and so is a requireBothDetected that is not TRUE or FALSE, as in flagReplicateDiscordance. An integer tolerance is stored as a double.

See also

flagISNV, which applies the rule, and flagReplicateDiscordance.

Examples

rule <- ConcordanceRule(freqTolerance = 0.05)
rule
#> ConcordanceRule object
#>   freqTolerance:       0.05 
#>   requireBothDetected: TRUE 
ISNVFilter(replicateConc = rule)
#> ISNVFilter object
#>   minDepth:      100 
#>   freq range:   [0.03, 0.5]
#>   minAltReads:   10 
#>   maxStrandBias: 10 
#>   replicateConc: freqTolerance 0.05, requireBothDetected TRUE
